maps.name: Drop-Off
maps.description: An industrial rooftop arena with control rooms, elevated platforms and working ziplines.
maps.notes: Adds 366 source placements: conduits, clamps, tanks, crates, furniture and structural details. Uses 97.06% of native world index capacity with no added dynamic entities. Preserves minimap, Northstar banners, displays, paint, lighting, safety volumes and ziplines. Some scenery and animated materials remain incomplete. Intro and evac are disabled.

maps.name: Phase Runner
maps.description: Snow, rock and industrial tunnels connect opposing bases beneath the phase machinery.
maps.notes: Adds 432 source scenery placements: supported ground plants, flowers, small snow rocks and power equipment. Uses 97.04% of native world index capacity with no added dynamic entities. Preserves minimap, displays, paint, lighting, team modes and catwalks. AI navigation and some layered/animated materials remain incomplete.

maps.name: Overflow
maps.description: An industrial arena with elevated lanes, molten channels and opposing bases.
maps.notes: 0.2.0 restores the 259 omitted local source lights through shadow-aware diffuse bakes with source spotlight cones, alongside 56 native RTL lights. Existing geometry, collision and sunlight remain. Decorations and animated shaders remain incomplete. Restart between new preview maps; the earlier repeated-mode-change crash remains unresolved.

maps.name: Party Crasher
maps.description: City streets, multilevel buildings and the crashed Voyage form a compact pilot arena.
maps.notes: 0.2.0 restores the 809 omitted local source lights through shadow-aware diffuse bakes with source spotlight cones, alongside 56 native RTL lights. Surface and character lighting are updated without adding light slots or geometry. Decorations and source shader behavior remain incomplete. Restart between new preview maps; the earlier repeated-mode-change crash remains unresolved.

maps.name: Firing Range
maps.description: The original training landscape adapted as a Titanfall pilot sandbox.
maps.notes: 0.2.0 restores 20 source supply bins with collision, seven native zipline pairs and non-solid backdrop water. The water has an adapted static appearance; Apex waves/reflections and loot interactions are not reproduced. Uses 91.51% of measured world index capacity. Dense scenery and some materials remain incomplete. Pilot modes are tested with one client. Restart between new preview maps; the earlier repeated-mode-change crash remains unresolved.
